bibliographic.title: Kisaragi Station
bibliographic.author: Shane
bibliographic.description:
You were just trying to get home after a long shift. You closed your eyes for five minutes. Now, the train has stopped at a station that shouldn't exist on any map. The air is too still, the GPS won't update, and the man in the distance is playing a drum that sounds a bit too much like a heartbeat.

Kisaragi Station is a choice-based horror experience built in Twine. Navigate the liminal space of a Japanese urban legend where the greatest threat isn't what's lurking in the dark—it's the realization that you might have already left the real world behind.
